data.description: Exclusive Waterfront Living with a Longevity Lifestyle
data.long_description:
Avida Residences offers exclusive waterfront living in Dubai Islands, designed for those seeking longevity, comfort, and elegance. Panoramic glazing and open layouts create light-filled interiors with serene views.

Homes feature high ceilings, generous terraces, and premium interior finishes. Kitchens and bathrooms are equipped with top-tier appliances and natural materials for a refined everyday experience.

The development provides wellness-driven amenities including a spa, smart fitness center, movement studio, and meditation spaces. Social lounges and personalized services foster a connected yet private community.
